symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1417: describe of a published REST service dropped the service-level authentication parameter list (Siemens FSM template NativeRestAPI.DocumentShare: query `jwt` bound to $Token of the custom-authentication microflow), and re-executing it failed MDL-REST04 'its parameters can only be a System.HttpRequest and a System.HttpResponse (CE0336)' — the microflow was valid in Studio Pro only because of the list MDL could neither print nor state
cause: model.PublishedRestService had no field for Rest$PublishedRestService.Parameters: the reader never read it, the writer carried it as an unauthored top-level key, the grammar's `microflow M.F` auth method took no list, and publishedRestAuthMicroflowProblem treated every non-request parameter as one Mendix cannot supply
file: mdl/executor/cmd_published_rest.go, mdl/executor/validate.go, mdl/backend/modelsdk/published_rest_write.go, mdl/backend/modelsdk/integration_read.go, mdl/grammar/domains/MDLService.g4, mdl/visitor/visitor_rest.go, mdl/ast/ast_rest.go, model/types.go
fix: `microflow M.F ($Token: header 'X-Api-Token', $Tenant: query, $Lang: query 'lang' description '…')`; an unlisted non-request parameter defaults to a query parameter under its own name, the type is always the microflow parameter's; MDL-REST04 refuses an unknown $Param, the request/response, a kind other than query/header, a duplicate; unstated authentication merges the stored list over the derived one (mergeOperationParameters); each parameter carries the stored $ID of the element with the same MicroflowParameter binding; Parameters left publishedRestServiceUnauthored and are written from the model with the operation parameters' property set; describe prints the list only when it differs from the default
test: mdl/executor/cmd_published_rest_auth_params_test.go; mdl/backend/modelsdk/published_rest_auth_test.go TestPublishedRestService_WritesAuthenticationParameters; mdl/visitor/visitor_rest_auth_test.go TestPublishedRestAuthentication_Parameters; mdl-examples/bug-tests/1417-published-rest-auth-parameters.mdl (11.6.6: 0 mx check errors; control with Parameters not written: CE0336 on both services)
insight: The Studio Pro reference came from the marketplace: the FSM template the reporter named is content 204718, a 2023 v1 .mpr, and `ListRawUnitsByType` + the NDSL renderer printed its one non-empty service Parameters list in seconds — a rename (jwt -> $Token), same five properties as an operation parameter. The mx control that settled the defaulting rule is cheap: build a binary that writes no Parameters and mx check names every unbound microflow parameter in one CE0336 ('not present in the custom authentication parameter list'). No Studio Pro-authored header parameter was found; header acceptance rests on mx check 11.6.6 reporting 0 errors.
